description: Gravity, a DNS server for the home network, over its API. The zone itself is the record @. A zone made with the web interface's Gravity-hosted preset answers from memory first, and Gravity, v0.34.0 at least, then answers with one record of each type: a host with several IPv6 addresses resolves to one of them. Leave the zone its etcd handler alone for all of them to be answered.

zone.description: The zone, with its final dot: home.lan.

ttl.description: The records' TTL: 5m, 1h. Default: 5m. Gravity has it per record since v0.32, and needs it there.
